spec.name: System Topology & Layering Architecture Quality Standard

rules.statement: Architecture must adhere to Monolith-First; choosing microservices requires team size > 50 or proven heterogeneous bottleneck justification
System layering structure must not exceed 3 layers, with clear unidirectional module dependencies and zero circular dependencies
Must provide a clear C4 Container diagram defining deployment nodes, runtime processes, and module responsibility boundaries
